Decisions

D-1 · accepted · 2026-10-14 · from Q-1 (mockups round 2)

Context Round 1 showed a switch, a segmented control and a dropdown. A switch cannot express "follow my device".

Decision We will use a three-way segmented control (System, Light, Dark) in the Appearance row, as in round 2 option B.

Consequences All three choices are visible at once; on phones the control takes a full row.

Supersedes — · Superseded by —

D-2 · accepted · 2026-10-14 · from Q-2

Context The choice must survive a reload (SC-2) and be readable before the first paint. A server call cannot answer before the page paints.

Decision We will store the choice in browser storage under the key notebook.theme, with the values system, light or dark.

Consequences The choice is per device. Sync across devices is deferred. When storage is blocked, the app falls back to System.

Supersedes — · Superseded by —

D-3 · accepted · 2026-10-14 · from Q-3

Context The cover sheet and control flow revision 1 were ready for review with one assumption and no open markers.

Decision We will build to cover sheet revision 1 and control flow revision 1, with one checkpoint review after P-1 and an end review.

Consequences The implementer stops after P-1 for review before building the UI.
